All the writing for Episode 2 has concluded, and we are now working through all the artwork, animations, and coding requirements. Immediately below, we take a very quick sneak peek at just a couple of the upcoming story elements and gameplay images with a more detailed development update in the next few weeks.

[b][h3]DETECTIVE AMBER & HER DEDICATED SIDEKICK[/h3][/b]
The administration is scrutinising the Chicks, Apes, and Wolves, and while things have settled down at the Chicks after their presidential election, everyone’s nervous about what’s going on behind the scenes. And who do you call when there’s a mystery abound at San Vallejo College? Detective Amber and her dedicated sidekick are on the case.

[b][h3]PENELOPE'S ADULT VISUAL NOVEL[/h3][/b]
Penelope tries to figure out how she can use her computer engineering powers for good, so she starts experimenting with the development of an adult visual novel.  And as we all know, sometimes the best stories are those built from your own experiences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42095008/188d505cd9b154932bf58800c97556c379de79b5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42095008/b44df6c9d7264185dcd098b8c26253af0f8dc565.png[/img]

Whilst Episode 2 may be smaller, it will be of much higher quality, particularly from a writing and plot perspective, with more exciting and meaningful scenes.

Going forward, we intend to release a new College Kings 2 Episode every 2-3 months and we’ve already outlined the entire rest of the season.  We will confirm an exact release date for “The Pool Party” soon.

The community feedback driven Episode 1 Major Update is finally here, and it's free to all existing owners! We care deeply that you love the games you buy from us, which is why we spend the last two months improving Episode 1 based on your comments.

notes.title: Announcing College Kings 2!
notes.content:
When College Kings started as a bedroom project just 18 months ago, we never imagined the huge amount of popularity it would gain. We didn’t intend to do more than 3 acts, but with such an incredible community, there is simply no way we’re stopping now.

Since our humble beginnings, we have grown to become a studio of award-winning writers, accomplished artists and brilliant coders. With our team constantly raising the bar for what it means to be an Adult Visual Novel, [b]we believe it’s time for a new beginning.[/b]

College Kings has never been more exciting. Welcome to the new era of stunning visuals, immersive sex scenes and a vast branching narrative where every choice matters.

[b]College Kings 2 Act I will replace what used to be Act IV[/b], with the story continuing right where Act III left off. But don’t worry, your decisions and relationships from the first game carry over.

[b]What you can expect from College Kings 2:[/b]
[list]
[*] Get excited for more content in every release
[*] Experience gorgeous graphics and cinematic artwork
[*] Shape the story, with more player impact than ever before
[*] Be fully immersed in beautiful high-definition animations
[*] Feel as if you’re there through all new sex scene voice acting
[*] Live out your fantasies with interactive foreplay
[*] Combine strategy and satisfying knockouts in the overhauled turn-based fight system
[*] Say goodbye to bugs with our reformed code structure
[*] Enjoy fast, stable downloads with small file sizes
[*] And for the first time ever, collect College Kings Steam Trading Cards
[/list]
College Kings 2 Act I is coming to Steam on April 14th.

[b]Wishlist College Kings 2 Act I now:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1924480/College_Kings_2__Act_I

To celebrate this new era of College Kings, we are making the first game, including all DLC, completely free with the launch of College Kings 2 Act I.
Additionally, we are adding more content to Act III which includes the conclusion of the Europe trip and multiple brand new, voice acted sex scenes!

Obviously a lot of you have already purchased Act II & III and we don't want you to feel as though you’re missing out. That’s why we’re giving anyone that bought Act II or III on Steam before the launch of College Kings 2 a free copy of the official CK walkthrough, filled with 220 pages of guidance on how to get every scene, achievement and relationship in the game.

Unfortunately Steam does not allow us to automatically carry your Act IV wishlist over to College Kings 2, so make sure you re-wishlist the game now!

[url=https://giv.gg/ck2]We’re still giving away 100 free copies on release.[/url]

If you’ve already entered the giveaway, make sure to also wishlist College Kings 2 Act I for the best chance of winning!

notes.title: College Kings v0.6 Release & Steam Achievements
notes.content:
The 0.6 update is here! This update adds almost an hour of new story, developing character paths and giving you more pathing than ever before. 

[b]Due to significant changes in code, saves from previous versions will not work. This is a one time occurrence and your saves will be compatible with future updates. We apologize for the inconvenience.[/b]

CHANGELOG V0.6

New content:
* 1200+ New Renders
* 20+ New Animations
* 3 Dates
* 2 Sex Scenes
* Wolves Rush Party
* Lots of main & side story progression

Gameplay:
* Even more pathing, making your choices matter more than ever before
* Added new achievements
* Added new scenes to scene selector
* New phone messages now rise to the top of contacts
* Steam Achievements support now added!

General Improvements:
* Changed a lot of the code, including revamping the entire phone code to enable a better foundation for the future

Bug Fixes:
* Fixed spelling & grammar errors from previous versions
* Fixed a lot of bugs
